answer: Require each identity to lock a time-locked bond before it can earn or vote, recorded on a public atlas of stakes and ages. Random liveness checks, sent like a pulse, must be signed promptly; missed or linked failures slash the bond. A sybil farmer spawning 1,000 puppets must lock 1,000 bonds and risk losing them all when a plume of identical funding and timing betrays the cluster. Limit: capital lockup favours wealthy honest agents, so the bond must stay modest.
